svg.title: MagicPilot LIVE on the Tab5, labelled
svg.desc: Photo of MagicPilot LIVE in the PRO view on an M5Stack Tab5 in the wireless configuration, showing the camera's live HDMI picture, with the hardware labelled: the wireless HDMI RX on top with the HDMI capture adapter plugged into it, the mini V-mount battery behind the mini V-mount plate on the Tab5's back, the braided cable from the HDMI capture adapter into the USB-A port, and power into the USB-C port.
